title: Journey kit
summary: patcher/journeys/support.mjs launches the built app for patch journeys without Node inspector flags (which packaged Electron fuses disable): a throwaway HOME and T3CODE_HOME seeded with the release launch fixture, Chromium's mock keychain, --background hooks installed in boot.cjs before app ready so no Dock icon or window is ever shown or focused (verified over a fixed stdio IPC channel on close), Playwright connected over --remote-debugging-port=0, telemetry and auto-update off, logs and screenshots into $T3_PATCHER_EVIDENCE, tearing down Electron's process group under bounded deadlines. patcher/check.mjs deduplicates patch Vitest and parallelized i18n checks against check:changed receipts for the exact git tree digest, and T3's Vitest suites cap worker concurrency from BSTACK_VERIFY_WORKERS.

journeys.name: app_opens
journeys.proves: The built app opens on an isolated home, lists the seeded thread in the sidebar and shows its message when opened.
